featured_reviews.name: Dhruv Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review Date : 16th May 2025 (edited : 10th September)
My Course: 11th + 12th + JEE 2026 (took admission in 2024 June)

- Batch size is maintained at 30 students as promised, which helps with better focus.
- PCM faculty includes two teachers per subject, specially Dev Sir (Chemistry Faculty) and Vinay Sir(Physics), are excellent for both Board and Entrance exam preparation.
- Teachers are friendly and supportive and teach twice, thrice ...until the student understands it.
- Reference books like Marvel, USS and MTG are solved well in class, which helps in strengthening fundamentals and PYQs.
- Classrooms are spacious.
- Physics is taught at a relatively higher level (by Vinay Sir), by making us solve MTG pyqs suitable for entrance exams (NEET and Mains).
- There are regular tests (they call it as DDO) which is good .
- Integrated(Dummy) System Available in this Coaching.
- They have partnershiped with a well known Coaching *Quantum*, a good initiative.

- Just a request, during admission time pls sir be present there, during mine only the miss was present and not all doubts I could ask to miss.
